name: Telegram Death Notifier
description: Sends a death screenshot to a Telegram channel

msg-run.name: Run message
msg-run.description: Startpos or practice run (death or 100%). Placeholders: {player}, {start}, {end}, {level}

custom-nickname.name: Use custom nickname
custom-nickname.description: Use the nickname below instead of your GD username

run-progress-title.name: Minimum run progress
run-progress-title.description: Independent of the old endpoint filter. A level must still be enabled in the pause menu.

run-progress-enabled.name: Enable minimum run progress
run-progress-enabled.description: Send when end minus start reaches the threshold, including practice checkpoint runs. Combines with the old filter using OR; disable the old row On toggle for step-only notifications.

minimum-run-progress.name: Minimum run progress (%)
minimum-run-progress.description: Minimum distance from the actual spawn to the first death/noclip collision or a clean 100%. Zero adds no distance restriction.

show-decimals.name: Show decimals
show-decimals.description: Off: truncate start/end to whole percentages for calculations and messages. On: round each endpoint to hundredths for both calculations and messages (up to two decimal places).

extra-title.name: Extra
extra-title.description: Defaults for levels you haven't configured yet

default-min.name: Default min percent
default-min.enable-if-description: Turn on "Enabled on all levels" first

only-best.name: Only new bests
only-best.description: Old filter only: normal-mode deaths from 0%. Does not restrict practice or the independent run-progress filter.
